rca_of_issue: Original failure: Gradle 9.3.1 rejected rootProject.name='T.E.R.E.S.A.' at settings.gradle:34 because project name cannot start or end with '.'. Root cause: Expo passes expo.name directly to Gradle as rootProject.name. Fix: strip trailing dot from expo.name only; preserve user-facing brand via platform-specific display name fields (ios.infoPlist.CFBundleDisplayName, Android label defaults to expo.name but on-screen branding comes from in-app strings so unaffected).
